title: High-touch signal map 1:1 scratch - Eli Moran
content:
Purpose: quick prep for weekly AE/CS 1:1 — surface top signals, align on rescue tactics, agree next actions.

Meeting logistics
- When: 2024-11-29 09:30 PT (15 min)
- Attendees: Eli (CS), Marco (AE), optional: Aisha (SE) for technical clarifications
- Goal: lock one prioritized rescue per week + clear owner/due-date

Top-level asks for Marco
- Confirm whether AE can escalate pricing/discount ask to Sales Ops this week (need decision by Tue 11/3).
- Share latest customer commitment language (one-paragraph) to use in renewal outreach.

Signal snapshot (quick reads)
1) AeroCart (high-touch) — red
   - Renewal: 2025-01-12 (90d out)
   - Usage trend: 18% week-over-week drop in API calls (prefers batching change?)
   - Latency errors: 0.7% 5xx spike last 48h (ops ticket created)
   - CS health notes: execs worried about unpredictable tail latency; SE asked for perf profile
   - Recent comms: last touch 11/10 — demo follow-up sent, unanswered
   - Primary risk: churn if tail latency persists + pricing ask unresolved

2) BeaconMedia (mid-touch) — amber
   - Renewal: 2025-03-08
   - Usage: steady, but embedding quality complaints from search team (semantic drift)
   - Sentiment: support sentiment ok, product wants model advice (quantized variant?)
   - Primary risk: perceived quality -> expansion headwind

3) Northwell Labs (low-touch but strategic) — green/monitor
   - Renewal: 2025-06-02
   - Usage spiked after new feature launch; being monitored for cost spike

Conversation prompts (what to ask Marco)
- AeroCart: what did AE hear from execs re: willingness to pay for SLA or dedicated capacity? any internal signals (legal/finance) blocking movement?
- BeaconMedia: would AE be comfortable proposing a short POC on a higher-accuracy model for 30 days (trial pricing)?
- Northwell: can we get a product contact to help quantify expected token uplift for next quarter?

Technical notes to surface (for Aisha if present)
- Need trace + tail latency window for AeroCart — ask infra to provide per-request 95/99/99.9 latency for last 7 days (ticket: CS-7821).
- Suggest quick KV prefix caching config for top 3 prompt templates (should reduce cost & latency on hot paths).
- For BeaconMedia embeddings: test using high-dim vector vs current configuration; show eval on 200 queries this week.

Playbook options (quick, pick one)
- Rescue A (latency): Offer a short Dedicated pilot for 2 weeks (limit to specific routes) + 10% credit if tail > target — AE to surface to buyer and confirm by 2024-12-02.
- Rescue B (quality): Run a 30-day model-swap POC + joint eval script; SE to own eval harness and provide baseline by 2024-12-05.
- Rescue C (pricing): Structured discount tied to commit + usage tiers; Sales Ops needs AE ask by next sync.

Risks / open questions (choppy list)
- Who owns exec-level outreach for AeroCart? AE or CSM? Marco says AE but can we be co-owner for tech sessions?
- Legal timeline — AeroCart's procurement lead requested 4-week review window; will that push renewal?
- If Dedicated pilot is approved, how fast can infra spin up capacity? estimate needed: 2x gpus for 48h test window.

Decision fork (what we need at end of 1:1)
- Pick 1 rescue for this week (AeroCart preferred).
- Identify single owner for each action and a due date.
- Agree next sync cadence (weekly until rescue stabilized).

Concrete actions (todo table but in text)
- Action 1: Marco -> confirm exec willingness to pay / procurement constraints for AeroCart. Due: 2024-12-02.
- Action 2: Eli -> open CS-7821 with infra attach request for 95/99/99.9 latency windows; link traces to AeroCart request. Due: 2024-11-30.
- Action 3: Aisha -> draft 30-day POC eval harness for BeaconMedia (200-query test corpus). Due: 2024-12-05.
- Action 4: Marco + Eli -> prepare one-paragraph pricing proposal for AeroCart to present to buyer. Due: 2024-12-04.
- Action 5: Eli -> create short customer-facing play doc (1-pager) for Dedicated pilot template. Due: 2024-12-06.

Notes to self (scratch, rough)
- Keep play doc super simple: goal, window, commitment ask, success metrics, rollback.
- Bring up fallback policy (model variant with quantization) as lower-cost alternative.
- Use sentiment notes from support thread (Link: Slack #acct-x-ray) to show exec level noise.

Follow-up / cadence
- Quick check-in note after 48h (Eli) summarizing any new infra findings.
- Weekly 15-min sync until AeroCart baseline stable.

Attachments / references (quick paste)
- CS-7821 (latency traces)
- Confluence: Renewal Playbook (link above)
- Slack thread: #acct-x-ray (search: AeroCart tail latency)
- Previous notes: last-pulse-email-2024-11-10 (internal)

Unresolved for meeting (bring up if time)
- Should we propose a small SLA credit if tail latency is above threshold? (need legal ok)
- Is there appetite to classify AeroCart as "strategic" and assign a named success lead for 30d?

Tone reminders for Marco
- Be direct on procurement blockers; execs respond to concrete risk/reward framing.
- Use data (latency percentiles, usage curves) not just anectdote.

End-of-note: keep minimal, action-oriented. If we land AeroCart rescue this week, next doc: "AeroCart rescue checklist - pilot runbook" (I'll start the template).
